outlook.statement: India's energy transition, rapid infrastructure expansion, and increasing investments in renewable energy continue to create sustained demand for electrical equipment, transformers, motors, and power solutions. Government initiatives such as the National Infrastructure Pipeline, PM Gati Shakti, and continued emphasis on domestic manufacturing provide a strong foundation for long-term industry growth. The company is well positioned to participate meaningfully in this evolving landscape.

Priorities remain firmly anchored on sustainable value creation: strengthen leadership position in Power Generation & Distribution business, further improve profitability of Rotating Machines segment, complete capital reallocation initiatives to improve financial strength, achieve sustainable profitability driven by operational excellence, and expand customer relationships and market presence both within India and internationally.

The Company expects demand for its product portfolio across sectors such as Defence, Railways, and various industrial sectors, supported by the Government's initiatives to boost domestic manufacturing. The Company continues to navigate persistent competition, volatile raw material prices, and the need for continuous technological upgrades.

Based on the resources available and projected sales, the Company expects to reduce the negative net worth by the end of financial year 2026-27, without factoring in the monetisation of non-core assets.

The company is in advance stage for monetization of its Assets, which will improve the working capital and in turn improve the performance in the forthcoming periods. The company is confident that this funding will have a positive impact on the performance and net worth.

The company is in advance stage of negotiation for monetization/disposal of assets which will improve the working capital and in turn improve the performance in the forthcoming periods. The company is confident that this funding will have a positive impact on the performance and net worth.
